runtimeDependencies.evidence: Assets/AssemblyShadowDemo/AssemblyA/Implementation/Extensibility/AssemblyA.Implementation.Extensibility.asmdef declares Contracts as the module contract. The current base class uses no Contracts type token, so C# omits the AssemblyRef. This explicit coordinated-upgrade dependency preserves the Contracts -> Extensibility -> Internal/ExtensibilityConsumer closure required by design section 1.2 without changing the frozen M01 business DLLs.

The M00 regression invokes AssemblyShadowBaseline.HotUpdate.Entry after its exact configured byte-image guard verifies SHA-256 before Assembly.Load. This edge declares the entry dependency; it does not authorize an unguarded byte load.
The M02 guard probe resolves the literal ordinary-hot-update entry only after the verified fixed-image guard loads the declared image, and checks physical assembly identity before invoking Run.

The M04 ordinary regression invokes the literal M00 Entry only after the existing fixed-image guard verifies the configured SHA-256 and loads those exact bytes. Name lookup before loading observes only the generated token-zero placeholder; this dependency does not authorize raw-byte or file acquisition.
